subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: Which pre-auth Control UI connection details may be shown and copied in an ephemeral browser diagnostic log?
rationale: The useful information is exactly the sensitive boundary: handshake frames, auth/device identity failures, origin checks, and close reasons can help support but may disclose credentials, identifiers, or deployment details if exposed too broadly.

options.title: Allowlist Redacted Browser Timeline
options.body: Expose only browser-observed lifecycle phases, normalized error codes, timings, and redacted recovery hints in memory with copy/export redaction.

options.title: Authenticated Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep pre-auth details out of the UI and focus on the authenticated safe diagnostics page tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102689.

options.title: Broader Log Streaming
options.body: Permit gateway-side log streaming once authenticated, but require a separate design for what can ever be surfaced before auth completes.

recommendation.title: Allowlist Redacted Browser Timeline
recommendation.body: Expose only browser-observed lifecycle phases, normalized error codes, timings, and redacted recovery hints in memory with copy/export redaction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the adjacent safe UI diagnostics issue and has the strongest recent history on Control UI auth/reconnect UX and docs.
